2116202219242750354.en_summary: $GS CEO: The people developing AI models and infrastructure have to take responsibility for what they're building so that it works and doesn't do harm. Companies embedding them must be responsible for deployment and impact. Goldman Sachs has used AI-type models for trading for almost 20 years with human accountability attached to every platform. We wouldn't deploy if we didn't have control and a human accountable for anything that goes wrong.
2116202219242750354.zh_summary: $GS 行政總裁：開發這些 AI 模型及基礎設施的人必須對他們所建造的東西負責，確保其運作且不會造成傷害。將這些產品嵌入企業和服務的公司必須對部署方式及其影響負責。高盛已使用 AI 類型模型進行交易平台近 20 年，每個平台都附有人類問責。如果我們不覺得有能力適當管理且有人類最終對任何錯誤負責，我們不會部署它。
